_how: Newest first. When sw.js VERSION changes, add an entry with the SAME v. 'student' items are shown to students in the update window, 'trainer' items on the trainer board. Leave a list empty if that side has nothing new (they then see 'Small fixes and improvements').

trainer: Tidier board: the colour key is one short row (folded on phones), and Video link, Classroom links, Export, Board settings and Log out are under More.

student: My team: chat with your team (your trainer can read it too) and see work your teammates shared with you.
After you submit an activity, you can share it with one, some or all of your team. They can use it and submit it, or review it first.
trainer: Teams (button on the board): make teams from the student list, read and write in every team's chat, and see when work was shared.

student: Lesson videos now play just the part you are reading and stop at the end of that topic. Tap Watch again, or go on to the next part.
Days 4 and 5 now have their demo videos in the lesson too.
trainer: Lesson videos are short clips stored with the lab: each stops at the end of its topic. Days 4 and 5 have videos now.

student: Activity 4.1 now has the database right inside it: open Tables to see the columns and keys, tap Show rows to peek at a table, and run your COUNT queries there. The SQL tab has Show rows too.
Updates now arrive while you work: this window tells you, and your work stays saved.
trainer: Open boards learn about updates within about a minute and show this window (you can finish grading first).

student: Submit window: choose to turn in your work in the lab's Workbook, or a link to your Google Sheets / Excel file.
If your trainer asks for a redo, you see it on Home, and your answers are still there to fix and submit again.
trainer: Return for redo: click a cell › Ask for a redo. The student keeps their answers and submits again.
Pages use the full width next to the menu.

student: New menu: a sidebar on computers and tabs at the bottom on phones (Home, your Day, Progress, Account).
My progress has a new look: your next step, your trainer's feedback, and each day's activities in plain words.
Lesson videos now start at the right part. On the Demo video page, tap a chapter to jump to it.
